name: KENNEDY, Simon Peter

headline.note: Kennedy's sources establish private legal, consulting and investment work and a Commonwealth-department advisory role, but do not supply exact boundaries, hours, leave or substantive full-time status. Study, candidacy and elected office are excluded. Missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.role: Paralegal / graduate lawyer specialising in mergers and acquisitions
career_spells.evidence_note: Frozen extract names paralegal; member biography describes graduate mergers-and-acquisitions work. Public indexed LinkedIn experience gives Clayton Utz December 2005–May 2007. Direct profile inaccessible (999); month dates provisionally retained with provenance, not exact days. Title progression, hours, leave, study overlap and PM&C arrangement unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private legal employment is supported, but no substantive full-time interval is established.

career_spells.employer: Australian Government Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract names the Commonwealth department and adviser role but supplies no dates, branch, classification, appointment basis, hours or leave. A departmental role is treated as public service, not political staff, absent evidence of employment in a ministerial office. Secondary synthesis describes energy-reform advice to PM&C from Clayton Utz. Direct APS appointment versus external legal assignment is therefore unresolved; existing departmental classification is provisional, and this spell must not be counted separately from legal work without payroll/secondment evidence.
career_spells.counting_note: Government employment is supported, but no exact or substantive full-time interval is established.

career_spells.role: Earlier McKinsey affiliation/work interval; position and appointment type unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: Employer alumni notice records separate06–06 tenure alongside08–22. Identity anchored to Cook election. This is evidence of a distinct2006 interval but source does not identify intern versus permanent appointment, payment, individual office allocation, dates or hours. Overlap with UNSW study and Clayton Utz role retained; no assumption of two simultaneous full-time jobs.
career_spells.counting_note: Employment basis and hours unresolved; no year of service or full-time duration assigned from same-year shorthand.

career_spells.role: Management consultant; later Partner and co-leader of Australian Public Sector and Technology Practices
career_spells.evidence_note: Consultancy.com.au reports that Kennedy joined in 2008, worked in Washington, New York and Sydney, became a partner in 2016 and left in 2022; his biography describes the Australian practices he co-led. Exact appointment and departure dates, hours, leave, partnership status and any 2022 campaign leave are unresolved. Contemporary AAP reports late2021 departure, conflicting with later2022 account. Existing boundary retained pending employer evidence; neither date establishes hours. Employer alumni notice7May2024 identifies Kennedy as elected Member for Cook and records office/tenure shorthand WASH,SYDN06–06,08–22. This independently supports recorded2008–2022 employer tenure while preserving late2021 active-departure report as a potentially distinct last-working-day/leave issue. It does not prove full-time hours.
career_spells.counting_note: Long private-sector employment is strongly supported, but year-only boundaries and absent hours prevent a full-time total.

career_spells.role: Co-founder / Partner in technology investment and government/CEO advisory services
career_spells.evidence_note: Kennedy's public LinkedIn summary identifies a former Banksia partnership; the secondary synthesis reports that he formed the technology investment firm after leaving McKinsey in 2022. The legal entity, exact dates, equity/remuneration, hours, leave, 2022 campaign overlap and endpoint before election are unresolved. Member biography now independently corroborates former Banksia partnership but supplies no boundaries. Public interest-register index lists Banksia Growth Pty Ltd; original declaration returned 403 Forbidden, so legal-employer identity remains a lead and is not assumed from a shareholding. Current first-party member biography specifically describes advisory work for government leaders and CEOs across Australia,US,Asia and Caribbean. This expands supported activity beyond passive investment but does not identify legal payroll entity or full-time conditions.
career_spells.counting_note: Private investment work is supported, but no substantive full-time interval is established.

career_spells.evidence_note: FY2021 officers report gives appointment August 2020; 2020 review identifies concurrent McKinsey partner. End, remuneration and hours unresolved. Governance appointment is separate from paid consulting. FY2022 officers report, dated27October2022, still lists Kennedy without a resignation annotation. This corroborates service in that reporting period, not indefinite continuation; end remains unknown. FY2023 Officers Report, visually inspected PDF page3/printed page2, expressly records Simon Kennedy resigned October2022. This resolves the previously unknown endpoint at month precision; no exact day, payment or hours are supplied.
career_spells.counting_note: Nonprofit governance excluded; no substantive full-time employment inferred.

career_spells.counting_note: Occasional guest lecturing does not establish substantive full-time work.

career_spells.evidence_note: Public reporting records Liberal endorsement on 23 March 2022 and candidacy through the 21 May federal election. Remuneration, hours and any leave from McKinsey are unresolved; candidacy is not assumed to be employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Party and campaign activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Public reporting records preselection on 4 March 2024 and election on 13 April 2024. Remuneration, hours and overlap with Banksia are unresolved; candidacy is not assumed to be employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Party and campaign activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and current biographies establish election at the Cook by-election on 13 April 2024 and continuing House service. Parliamentary and shadow-ministry roles are nested within elected office.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: First-person2022 candidate questionnaire states service on Ryde City Youth Council alongside school leadership. Dates, terms, remuneration and hours unknown. Advisory participation, not substantive council employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Youth advisory/governance service excluded from employment totals.

research_notes: The frozen occupation sequence is preserved, while the unidentified management-consulting employer is resolved to McKinsey from member-controlled and industry sources.
The PM&C role is classified as public service because the frozen source names the department; no evidence was found that it was a ministerial-office appointment.
McKinsey's 2008–2022 tenure and 2016 partner promotion are not converted to full-time years because sources do not establish hours, leave or exact boundaries.
Candidate intervals are displayed separately and excluded; they are not used to fill employment gaps or infer leave from McKinsey or Banksia.

2026-10-01 follow-up adds three first-speech early jobs, Committee for Sydney August 2020 appointment from original financial statements and guest lecturing. Clayton Utz month dates are explicitly public indexed-profile evidence; no hours inferred from title or duration.

Searched original employer reports, Banksia/Kassabgi company leads, public professional dates and PM&C descriptions. Reject Canadian public servant, UK designer and journalist namesakes. Banksia Growth interest-register link remains unverified because APH PDF returned 403; do not equate an investment holding with legal employer. FY2022 Committee PDF timed out; FY2021 and 2020 original reports opened. No campaign leave, full-time terms or precise Banksia endpoint evidence found.

Second follow-up2October2026 adds omitted Ryde youth advisory service, retrieves previously timed-out FY2022 Committee financial report and records conflicting consulting departure evidence. No hours inferred and no unsupported replacement of existing supported dates.

Searched Banksia legal entity, committee resignation, contemporary consulting departure and supermarket identity. New Zealand Foodstuffs executive Simon Kennedy and Clarence Property employee are namesakes and excluded. Banksia partnership repeats earlier evidence without payroll/control details. Future leads: FY2023/24 Committee officers reports; original McKinsey departure/leave record; Ryde youth committee minutes; original Banksia entity disclosures.

Follow-up3October2026 follows recorded FY2023/24 report lead and resolves Committee for Sydney resignation to October2022 from original FY2023 officers table. FY2024 financial report and2023 AGM minutes contain no Kennedy match and supply no further personal conditions. Generic about-us reader was inaccessible but specific primary reports were accessible. PDF rendered locally to verify corrupted text. No full-time years inferred. Next substantive leads remain McKinsey employer departure evidence, Banksia legal/payroll distinction and Ryde youth minutes.

Fourth follow-up4October2026 used exact Banksia Growth, McKinsey departure and Ryde City Youth Council searches. Public interests indexes repeat Banksia Growth Pty Ltd as a private-company holding/directorship but do not prove the consulting payroll entity or work dates. Contemporary March2022 reporting still describes Kennedy as a McKinsey partner, adding no reliable resolution to the recorded late2021/2022 departure conflict. Ryde results repeat youth-council service without term or pay. No material change; company holding is not silently converted into employment.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Primary McKinsey alumni notice supplies omitted2006 interval plus employer08–22 tenure shorthand; separate unknown-basis spell added without inventing internship or full-time status. Current member biography identifies Banksia active advisory services, rather than only tech investment. Named Banksia consulting sites returned unrelated clinical/ecological firms and are not assigned to this member. Existing late2021/2022 active-departure versus nominal-tenure conflict retained.

Follow-up2026-10-05: Targeted Banksia Growth legal-entity, Clayton Utz energy-reform/PM&C arrangement and City of Ryde youth-council archive searches returned the existing public interests index, parliamentary biography and derivative profiles; no appointment/payroll or contemporary youth terms located. Direct official biography still lists PM&C adviser without dates or appointment basis. Canadian senior public servant/Teneo adviser, British Wates environmental developer, photographer and theological author namesakes rejected. No material employer/date/hours change. Next useful routes: original personal declaration if ordinarily accessible, PM&C personnel or secondment record, and original youth-council minutes; do not repeat generic biography searches or treat shareholding as consulting employment.

Second targeted pass2026-10-05 tested former Clayton Utz energy-advice and Banksia investment-partner routes. Official biography again identifies PM&C adviser without appointment basis; no personal secondment/payroll recovered. New8May2025 SmartCompany lead reports Banksia/HappenCo merger into Luminary Partners and prior UNSW Defence10x support, but it does not name Kennedy or prove this corporate successor was his employer. UNSW Founders public pages concern programme/startup investments, not his appointment; current Defence10x URL404. Retain Luminary historical Banksia/UNSW archive as a new research avenue, without assigning a merger date or programme funds as personal remuneration. Jolt shareholding and current director-interest indexes do not establish payroll/work status. Entertainer/ecologist and other namesakes excluded; no material personal dates/hours change. Lead URLs: https://www.smartcompany.com.au/startupsmart/unsw-founders-fund-18-startups-200000-luminary-partners/ ; https://unswfounders.com/demo-day-2024/wa-spaceport (retrieved2026-10-05). Neither names Kennedy as programme worker or establishes personal term; verify identity before adopting.

Third targeted pass2026-10-06 re-ran exact McKinsey2006, Banksia Growth and Clayton Utz/PM&C energy-reform searches. Results reproduce the employer alumni06–06/08–22 shorthand, current interests transcription and derivative career narrative; none identifies the2006 appointment type, Banksia payroll entity, PM&C appointment or secondment basis, exact dates, hours or leave. The Canadian senior public servant, British developer and similarly named NSW environment employee were excluded. No material personal employment fact changed. Future work should target an original appointment/engagement instrument or historical Banksia filing rather than further generic biography searches.

Was Committee for Sydney governance remunerated, and what exact day in October2022 did it end? What dates/payment applied to Wharton guest lecturing?
